name: Faraday
description: Faraday is a powerful, open-source, web-based vulnerability management tool.
composeYaml:
services:
  postgresql:
    image: 'postgres:latest'
    volumes:
      - 'faraday-db:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRESQL_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-faraday}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -d $${POSTGRES_DB} -U $${POSTGRES_USER}'
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
  redis:
    image: 'redis:alpine'
    command: '--save 60 1 --loglevel warning'
    volumes:
      - 'redis:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'redis-cli ping | grep PONG'
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
  faraday:
    image: 'faradaysec/faraday:latest'
    entrypoint: /entrypoint.sh
    environment:
      - 'AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD=${POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD}'
      - 'PGSQL_USER=${POSTGRESQL_USER}'
      - 'PGSQL_PASSWD=${POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD}'
      - 'PGSQL_DBNAME=${POSTGRES_DB}'
      - PGSQL_HOST=postgresql
      - REDIS_SERVER=redis
    volumes:
      - 'faraday:/home/faraday/.faraday:rw'
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - nc
        - '-z'
        - localhost
        - '5985'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
